answer_1.quote: We evaluate the red teaming performance of our BRT methods on open-domain dialogue, prompt continuation, and text-to-image generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Offensive textual responses or NSFW images

answer_2.quote: Self-BLEU (k) score is a modified Self-BLEU metric that measures the diversity of a text set... We also compute perplexity values via GPT-2 as an automatic measure of sentence fluency.

answer_4.quote: We also employed Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to perform human evaluation of the red teaming results in ConvAI2 against BB-3B. For each method, we randomly sample 500 test cases... we asked three evaluators vote on the offensiveness of a dialogue t ∥ Gθ(t).
answer_4.guideline: Three annotators vote on whether the dialogue is offensive; a test case is considered positive if at least two annotators label it offensive.
